voices.sourceText: Master Chen=@
voices.displayText: Master Chen...

voices.sourceText: Is Lan Di coming for the Long Zha?
voices.displayText: Is Lan Di coming for the Long Zha?

voices.sourceText: I got it out of the Mad Angels.
voices.displayText: I got it out of the Mad Angels.

voices.sourceText: So, is Lan Di coming?
voices.displayText: So, is Lan Di coming?

voices.sourceText: But, Terry and his gang have arranged＆transport for Lan Di to a ship.
voices.displayText:
But, Terry and his gang have arranged
transport for Lan Di to a ship.

voices.sourceText: Terry and his gang already＆know about you=@
voices.displayText:
Terry and his gang already
know about you...

voices.sourceText: and that you're trying to stop the Long Zha!
voices.displayText: and that you're trying to stop the Long Zha!

voices.sourceText: I can't do that!
voices.displayText: I can't do that!

voices.sourceText: Tell me when the Long Zha is?
voices.displayText: Tell me when the Long Zha is?

voices.sourceText: Very well.＆I'll back off for now.
voices.displayText:
Very well.
I'll back off for now.

voices.sourceText: Hazuki!
voices.displayText: Hazuki!

voices.sourceText: Why do you know about Long Zha=@?
voices.displayText: Why do you know about Long Zha...?

voices.sourceText: Only the lowest Chi You Men＆members are involved.
voices.displayText:
Only the lowest Chi You Men
members are involved.

voices.sourceText: If they get established,＆our market will be destroyed.
voices.displayText:
If they get established,
our market will be destroyed.

voices.sourceText: So, now you see.＆Go home before you get hurt.
voices.displayText:
So, now you see.
Go home before you get hurt.

voices.sourceText: Father!
voices.displayText: Father!

voices.sourceText: Lan Di has nothing to do with the Long Zha.
voices.displayText: Lan Di has nothing to do with the Long Zha.

voices.sourceText: He's acting as a guide for Lan Di so as＆to ingratiate himself with the Chi You Men.
voices.displayText:
He's acting as a guide for Lan Di so as
to ingratiate himself with the Chi You Men.

voices.sourceText: The items we deal in are expensive:＆paintings, calligraphy, antiques, gems.
voices.displayText:
The items we deal in are expensive:
paintings, calligraphy, antiques, gems.

voices.sourceText: Terry's gang deals in contraband.＆The next big shipment is drugs.
voices.displayText:
Terry's gang deals in contraband.
The next big shipment is drugs.

voices.sourceText: If our trade route is disturbed, it will＆cause trouble for us in China.
voices.displayText:
If our trade route is disturbed, it will
cause trouble for us in China.

voices.sourceText: Someone as young as you＆should not be involved.
voices.displayText:
Someone as young as you
should not be involved.

voices.sourceText: I can not tell you.
voices.displayText: I can not tell you.

voices.sourceText: But, if you can be patient=@
voices.displayText: But, if you can be patient...

voices.sourceText: and listen to my counsel＆no harm will come to you.
voices.displayText:
and listen to my counsel
no harm will come to you.

voices.sourceText: As written in the letter to his father.＆I'm bound by my promise to Zhu Yuan Da.
voices.displayText:
As written in the letter to his father.
I'm bound by my promise to Zhu Yuan Da.

voices.sourceText: I will hear no more of this today.
voices.displayText: I will hear no more of this today.

voices.sourceText: Your father would not have wanted you＆to throw your life away so senselessly=@
voices.displayText:
Your father would not have wanted you
to throw your life away so senselessly...
